title: Exact Cosine in the Third Quadrant
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Evaluate $\cos\left(\dfrac{5\pi}{4}\right)$ exactly, showing how the reference angle and quadrant determine the answer.

steps.title: Find Reference Angle and Quadrant
steps.explanation: The angle exceeds $\pi$ by $\pi/4$, placing it in the third quadrant with reference angle $\pi/4$.
steps.why: Writing the angle as $\pi$ plus an acute part immediately reveals both facts.

steps.title: Take the Magnitude from the Special Value
steps.explanation: Reference-angle reasoning transfers the known value $\cos(\pi/4)=\sqrt{2}/2$ to $5\pi/4$ in absolute size.
steps.why: Every angle shares its reference angle's trig magnitude.

steps.title: Attach the Negative Sign
steps.explanation: In Quadrant III the unit-circle $x$-coordinate is negative, and cosine equals that coordinate.
steps.why: Only tangent-type functions are positive in the third quadrant, so cosine must be negative there.
